Dina Soliman  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-54-123-4567 | dina.soliman@advertisesphere.com | linkedin.com/in/dinasoliman  

Over the past four years, I have specialized in securing ad-tech platforms through proactive risk mitigation and architecture-driven security. At AdvertiseSphere Inc., I transitioned from Security Analyst to Security Engineer, where I led the integration of encryption protocols that reduced data exposure risks by 40% across ad-hoc campaigns. My work involved continuous monitoring of network traffic, identifying 120+ anomalies annually, and refining firewall rules to block 98% of known attack vectors. At MediaNet Solutions, I designed IAM frameworks that streamlined user access while enforcing least-privilege principles, resulting in a 30% reduction in unauthorized access attempts. A key focus was penetration testing, which uncovered critical vulnerabilities in third-party ad-exchange integrations, prompting the implementation of SOC2-compliant controls. I also spearheaded the migration of legacy systems to TLS 1.3, enhancing end-to-end encryption for 80% of data in transit.  

Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, 2020  

Technical expertise spans application security, incident response, and infrastructure hardening. I routinely apply OWASP guidelines to secure ad-tech APIs, ensuring compliance with GDPR data protection mandates. For instance, I led the redesign of a customer data pipeline to address insecure direct object references, reducing breach risks by 25%. My incident response framework, built using Splunk and ELK stack, enabled real-time detection of 15+ security incidents in 2023, with mean time to resolve (MTTR) improved by 22%. In penetration testing, I focused on identifying misconfigurations in cloud environments, which led to the remediation of 50+ critical vulnerabilities across MediaNet’s ad-tech stack.  

I have architected encryption solutions using AES-256 and RSA-2048, ensuring secure key management through PKI infrastructure. My IAM implementations at MediaNet reduced administrative overhead by 40% while maintaining granular access controls for 1,200+ users. Network security initiatives included deploying zero-trust architectures that segmented sensitive ad-server components, cutting lateral movement risks by 65%.  

A side project involved developing a lightweight SIEM integration for small ad-tech startups, which automated log analysis and flagged 90% of potential threats within 48 hours. I also contributed to an open-source toolkit for threat modeling ad-tech ecosystems, which has been adopted by three local startups.  

Hebrew | English (fluent)  

Recognized for spearheading AdvertiseSphere’s SOC2 compliance initiative, which achieved audit clearance in 2023 with zero critical findings. My encryption framework at MediaNet was cited as a model for industry best practices, earning a regional cybersecurity award in 2022.
